name: The Starfall Annex
introDiscord:
"Beyond the celestial engine, carved stone gives way to something disturbingly familiar: sealed doors, dead terminals, faded warning lights, and an old institutional insignia Shizuki has very clearly drawn a mustache on."

---------------- ROOM 1 — APPROACH ----------------
introTwitch:
"Beyond the celestial engine, carved stone gives way to something disturbingly familiar: sealed doors, dead terminals, faded warning lights, and an old institutional insignia Shizuki has very clearly drawn a mustache on."

---------------- ROOM 1 — APPROACH ----------------

the-starfall-annex-approach.prompt: The ruined Starfall Annex stretches through the trench beneath layers of meteor dust. Three corridors remain open, and one terminal still displays a security warning that someone renamed 'Definitely_Not_Shizuki.'

left.message:
A Berry cache sits beneath the terminal.

Shizuki's note reads:

"If you're reading this, their dramatic security system lost again.

Also I improved the terminal name.

You're welcome."

right.message:
An old archive locker has split open beneath fallen starstone. Star Candies were apparently being stored alongside completely incomprehensible facility paperwork.

Shizuki has labeled the paperwork:

"BORING."

forward.message:
"A warning light flashes.

A Starfall Annex Grunt emerges from the ruined corridor.

After all this time, something here is still following orders."

---------------- ROOM 2 — DEPTHS ----------------

the-starfall-annex-depths.prompt: Deeper inside, the annex stops resembling a ruin and begins resembling a place someone deliberately abandoned. Old doors stand open. Shizuki's arrows cover the walls. Three routes lead toward the central archive.

left.message:
A Starfall Annex Grunt activates beneath an old recovery-order sign.

Someone has crossed out RECOVER SUBJECT and written:

"NO ♥"

The construct does not appreciate the edit.

right.message:
An old medical station still contains one usable restorative.

Across the cabinet, Shizuki wrote:

"Their medicine.

My bottle now.

Consider it back pay."
right.fullHpMessage:
The old medical supply remains untouched.

For once, this place has nothing you need.

forward.message:
"A sealed archive compartment opens.

Inside are Star Candies, damaged records, and a faded transit seal matching markings found elsewhere in Starfall Trench.

This place was connected to something larger."

---------------- ROOM 3 — THRESHOLD ----------------

the-starfall-annex-threshold.prompt: The final corridors converge beneath the Meteor Archive Command. Old insignias line the walls beside newer repairs, as though this place survived far longer than it should have.

left.message:
A damaged records vault has collapsed open.

Among the surviving documents are references to other annexes scattered across the Astral Sea.

Moonlit Lab was not alone.

right.message:
A final Starfall Annex Grunt steps between you and the command chamber.

Behind it, Shizuki has drawn a tiny mustache directly onto the warning placard.

Some traditions survive everything.

forward.message:
A restorative bottle rests beneath Shizuki's final trail note:

"Came back because I wanted answers.

Stayed because Glimmer found a button.

Leaving because Glimmer found another button.

If you're following us...

good luck~"
forward.fullHpMessage:
"You leave Shizuki's final restorative untouched.

Whatever waited for her beyond this point, she walked toward it by choice."

---------------- BOSS — METEOR ARCHIVE COMMAND ----------------

boss-antechamber.name: Meteor Archive Command
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The command chamber awakens.

Dead screens flicker to life one after another.

An old rank insignia appears across the central display while a uniformed silhouette steps from behind the sealed command dais.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Meteor Archive Command recognizes an intruder.

Old security systems awaken throughout the annex.

At the center of the chamber, a uniformed figure bearing an institutional rank waits beneath records that survived long after Moonlit Lab disappeared.

Whatever this place knows, something still intends to guard it.

Use /yes to enter Meteor Archive Command or /no to retreat before the annex fully awakens.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Meteor Archive Command recognizes an intruder.

Old security systems awaken throughout the annex.

At the center of the chamber, a uniformed figure bearing an institutional rank waits beneath records that survived long after Moonlit Lab disappeared.

Whatever this place knows, something still intends to guard it.

Use !yes to enter Meteor Archive Command or !no to retreat before the annex fully awakens.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw from Meteor Archive Command.

The old systems remain active behind you.

Beside the doorway, Shizuki's tiny handwritten arrow still points inward:

"Answers this way.

Probably."

boss.revealText:
The command dais unlocks.

The uniformed figure steps into the surviving light.

Starfall Annex Officer reveals itself!

completionText:
The Starfall Annex Officer falls.

The command archive finally opens.

Among its surviving records is the confirmation Shizuki once discovered here herself:

Moonlit Lab was never alone.

The facility belonged to a wider network of annexes scattered throughout the Astral Sea.

Yet the oldest records point farther onward, toward routes hidden beneath living roots and whispering currents.

Across the final terminal, Shizuki left one last message beside a doodle of herself and Glimmer:

"Came back on my own.

Added mustache.

Found answers.

Found more questions.

Glimmer already picked the next direction, so I guess we're going that way now~"

Beyond the annex, a distant current winds toward the Whispering Kelp Forest.

Starfall Trench is complete.

The journey isn't.
